name: color-picker
description: A composable color picker. ColorPicker holds the color and shares it with parts laid out in any way: ColorPickerTrigger and ColorPickerContent (a popover), ColorPickerPanel (a column of controls, or a standalone inline picker), ColorPickerArea (OKLCH chroma × lightness at the hue, the part sRGB can't show left blank; or HSB saturation × brightness), ColorPickerSlider (any channel of OKLCH, HSL, HSB or RGB, or alpha; horizontal or vertical, painted with the colors it reaches), ColorPickerFields (a format menu with hex or per-channel fields) and ColorPickerChannelInput, ColorPickerSwatches (presets, Tailwind's palette by default), ColorPickerSwatch, ColorPickerPreview and ColorPickerFixContrast; useColorPicker reads and sets the color from custom parts. format sets what onChange emits (oklch by default, hex, rgb or hsl) and alpha adds opacity controls. Given a background (contrastWith), every part shows contrast: the area hatches what fails AA and draws the AA and AAA thresholds across it, tracks hatch and mark them, presets failing AA are hatched, the preview shows the WCAG ratio and "Fix to AA/AAA" jumps to the nearest passing lightness keeping the hue. Without children, ColorPicker is a swatch that opens the default panel in a popover.
